race.comment: DANCE WITH DESTINY (7) good staying mare resuming. Can pull out a big run fresh and looks ready to go after the two soft trials. Look for her powering late. GOLD CUP (8) resumes on her home track after stretching out in trip last campaign. Fitted with the two searching trials and a forward showing is expected. NAVY SLIPPERS (12) is fitter for two runs back from a spell and appreciated the jump in trip when she savaged the line to finish second over 1500m at Hawkesbury. Stays in the calculations. PERINI MISS (13) returned from a lengthy break with a tiring fifth over 1313m at Taree. Strips fitter now and should appreciate the extra ground.
